concept.name: Temperature
concept.description: The archilexeme spanning the full scale of thermal sensation from extreme cold through neutral/ambient to extreme heat. A dynamic process concept — temperature rises and falls gradually over time rather than being a fixed static position.
concept.notes: GTCV selected over HL-BI because temperature is a DYNAMIC process concept — it rises and falls over time rather than being a static position on a spectrum. Key distinction: a learner says 'It is getting hotter' (process) not 'it IS hot right now' as a fixed location. States vocabulary covers the range from freezing to burning. Transitions vocabulary covers the process of heating and cooling. v1.1: Positions corrected for GTCV bell curve. 0=start(freezing), 50=peak(boiling), 100=end(freezing). Ascending half 0-50=getting hotter, descending half 50-100=cooling down. CRITICAL FIX: conceptData/transitionsData columns were [SL,TL] reversed from convention — corrected to [TL,SL,Quiz,Position].
